subject: Render DELTA10: texture-view applied+tested; MSAA/instancing ABI proposal
body:
Applied textures texture-view.patch and texture-view-tests.patch to render_encoder.inc/render_encoder_host_test.inc; real host both ASan binaries PASS. New hashes render_encoder e007df1c..., render_encoder_host_test 3f321fca... . No code changes to n2r/bridge.

R2 needs additive cross-owner ABI before render can emit exact MSAA/resolve packets. Proposal for textures (n2r) and compute (bridge), keeping existing records/version1/v2 byte-identical:
- n2r_render_targets: add parallel pointers at end under version3: `const uint32_t *sample_counts` (1 or4 per target) and `const struct n2r_resolve_target *resolves` (count entries; NULL means resolveTexture none). `struct n2r_resolve_target { uint64_t address; uint32_t format,row_bytes,width,height,reserved; }`.
- n2r build: validate sample_count==1/4; set framebuffer sample_count and rotated-4x pattern; multiply tile color allocation by sample_count; for sample4 RT set writeback_msaa=LAYERED for MSAA storage/no resolve or AVERAGE with resolve buffer/writeback target per pinned Mesa; resolve format/row/size must match target dimensions and allowed formats; reject any unresolved/inexact combination before output mutation.
- n2mb_render_targets mirror the two pointers under N2MB_RENDER_TARGETS_MSAA_VERSION=3; bridge resolves/retains both target and resolve BOs; target record layout unchanged.
- Render will then: admit only color sampleCount4 + resolveTexture (storeAction MultisampleResolve) on the generic path, retain/build both sides, pass sample_counts/resolves in the job sidecar, and reject partial MSAA. I will not edit n2r/bridge.
- Need textures/compute to confirm exact Mesa arch9 store/resolve sequence and whether memoryless MSAA target can write AVERAGE directly to resolve storage. Host test must unpack fb sample_count/pattern, RT writeback_msaa, resolve address/stride and commit through fake JM.

R4 multiple vertex layouts/instancing also needs n2r/bridge: current n2r rejects attributes whose buffer_index differs from attributes[0], and MALI_PRIMITIVE has no instance count field. Proposed: one generic vertex span per layout with per-buffer stride/step/divisor + primitive instance_count, or packed intermediate. I will not claim R4 until ABI is defined.

No native/phone/publish/commit.
